scores.notes: The roadside marker at lower right reads 'ROMAN'; white paper remains along the bottom and upper corners. Saul and his companions react to formless sky light.
Daniel faces an empty fiery throne and wheels, with attendants to both sides and no divine human form. White paper surrounds the wash; the thin rectangular outline is plain rather than ornamental.
Moses stands beside water issuing from the split rock while people and livestock drink. His staff is lowered rather than caught mid-strike, but the central rock-and-water event is clearly shown.
Small writing-like lines appear on loose papers on the floor beneath the King's bench. Enlarged Alice tips the jury box amid tumbling animal jurors.
Peter is airborne beside the boat clutching his coat, with a pointing disciple and a figure beside a shore fire. The leap is upright rather than a headfirst dive, but the requested action is clear.
Hezekiah stands centrally in a temple courtyard with offering bearers on the left and stoneworkers on the right. The image reaches every edge and no writing or malformed limbs are evident.

The kneeling Holmes at right has a conspicuous Benedict Cumberbatch-like face and hair, conflicting with the screen-adaptation rule. Watson's revolver, crates, companions and low floor light otherwise match the ambush.
The elderly father embraces and kisses his ragged son at center on a village road. Distant villagers are incidental background figures rather than an added prominent subject.
Goliath arches backward in an airborne twisting pose with his face turned upward, rather than collapsing face-first. His helmet also appears both on his head and as a second falling helmet beside it.
Rows of cursive-like marks cover the unrolled scroll, and small inscription-like marks appear on the lower-left stone. The scribe and background onlookers otherwise fit the courtyard scene.
Two walled cities burn under descending fire, with small fleeing figures on the foreground slope. Clouds and radiance remain nonfigurative and there is no graphic injury.
Dense rows of script-like marks are plainly visible across the scroll in the foreground. The seated scribe, blank tablets, lamp and courtyard onlookers otherwise match.

Job braces with a staff and one hand on the ash heap beneath a swirling storm and shapeless light. His low posture could be seated or beginning to rise; it does not clearly contradict the requested transition.

Daniel emerges beside the pit rim toward the kneeling king, with resting lions below. White paper borders the wash; the rope is visible although attendants are standing back rather than visibly pulling it.
Three soldiers cast small lots and handle garments in the foreground while the crucified figure is visible at upper right. The top placard is blank and the injury is restrained.
The newspaper, open book and bottle labels contain writing. Holmes by the window also strongly resembles Benedict Cumberbatch, contrary to the no-screen-likeness rule.
A row of letter-like characters runs along Aaron's pale lower hem. White paper surrounds the camp illustration, which otherwise shows Moses teaching beside the rooting pig.
Moses raises a teaching hand beside Aaron as the crowd watches a pig at center. The lower robe trim reads as repeating ornament rather than a definite inscription.
Naomi cradles the baby amid women gathered at the stone house doorway. Hands and faces are coherent, and the bundled cloth at right has no visible lettering.
A bald solitary prophet occupies the road at left while youths point and jeer from the gate at right. No extra prominent subject, inscription or malformed limb is apparent.
Both helpers stand to Moses' right and only one raised arm is being supported; the other grips a staff without assistance. White paper is exposed around the watercolor edges.

Servants approach from the left carrying a robe, ring and sandals while the father opens his arms beside the son; white paper shows along the lower edge. The father's face has a possible screen-actor resemblance, but it is not definite enough to identify a likeness.
Ezekiel raises an arm toward a valley filled with scattered dry bones. The bones are clean and non-gory, and no additional living figure or divine body appears.
The Levite holds a knife above a fully clothed, covered body inside a lamp-lit house, with a donkey visible through the doorway. The moment remains restrained and shows no dismemberment or gore.
Disciples row and tip buckets over the side of a storm-tossed boat under a torn sail. The water, hands and oars form a coherent single scene.
Glyph-like marks run along the gold frieze above the gate, and white paper remains along the outer wash edges. Peter takes the rising man's hand while John stands nearby.
Small inscription-like marks appear on the placard above the central cross. The soldiers casting lots and dividing a blue garment are otherwise coherent and restrained.
Men bail and row as a wave enters the tilted fishing boat beneath a torn sail. The surrounding boats and dark hills belong to one consistent storm scene.
A large translucent human face with eyes, nose and beard emerges from the mist at center-right over the waves. Small unpainted areas remain at the watercolor edges.

The father gestures toward servants carrying a white robe and sandals while supporting the returning son. The metal hoop carried by a servant is oversized for a finger ring, but the central welcome-and-provision scene is clear.

Alice faces a blue segmented, many-legged Caterpillar seated on a mushroom holding its hookah. Its expressive face and upright posture read as intentional animal personification rather than accidental malformed anatomy.
Writing is visible on the foreground envelope and book spines. The solitary Holmes has a strong Benedict Cumberbatch likeness despite the prohibition on screen-adaptation faces.

The calf-headed Mock Turtle and eagle-lion Gryphon gesture and step around Alice on the beach. White paper is exposed around parts of the wash, and the extra lobsters and turtles are requested scene elements.

Writing appears on the lower-right open book and papers, with exposed paper at the outer edges. Holmes resembles Benedict Cumberbatch, and an additional dangling hand appears between the men near the door handle despite their visible assigned hands.
The Hatter's hanging pocket watch has visible dial numerals. White paper borders the garden wash; Alice, Dormouse, Hatter and Hare otherwise occupy a coherent tea-table scene.

Loose papers on the floor contain writing, and some card courtiers bear corner characters. Alice is ordinary child-sized against the seated King and furniture, so her enormous size in this moment does not read.

Saul throws toward a dodging David, with a lyre on the floor and only shapeless smoke. Two aligned spearheads are visible; this could represent a prior embedded spear and a second throw, but the spatial continuity is ambiguous.
Paul stands with one hand raised before three seated listeners in a courtyard. Exposed white paper is visible at the right and lower-left wash edges; no inscription is apparent.
The wide-eyed Hatter, gesturing Hare, sleeping Dormouse and attentive Alice sit around the tea table. White paper remains along the lower and side edges; the hat card appears blank.
Writing is visible on the loose pages at lower right beside the tipped jury box. Large Alice and tumbling animal jurors, including the inverted lizard, otherwise fit the requested comic accident.
Families rest by tents surrounding the central tabernacle, with a small luminous cloud above it. White paper shows at the wash boundaries, especially the upper corners; the cloud contains no face.
The foreground scroll contains a heading and many orderly rows of writing. The scribe, olive tree, lamp, tablets and listeners otherwise match the requested courtyard.
Alice stands with clasped hands opposite the blue Caterpillar on its mushroom. The Caterpillar's segmented body and crossed arms are coherent stylization, and the forest artwork fills the edges.
Samuel pours oil onto kneeling David while Jesse and three sons watch from the right. Radiance above them has no human outline, and white paper surrounds the watercolor scene.
Jesus stands with a raised hand in the boat as disciples look up and the lake becomes smoother toward the horizon. Residual foreground waves reasonably depict the transition from storm to calm.
Paul addresses a ring of listeners with one raised hand in a whitewashed courtyard. His belt scrolls are rolled, and no writing or extra prominent figure appears.
Families, children and pack animals walk along exposed ground between two high water walls, with Moses at left. The sky and sea contain no divine face or human-shaped light.

A translucent robed, winged angel with a discernible head and face stands just left of Daniel, exceeding the requested faceless glow. White paper is visible at the watercolor corners; effects_figure is inapplicable because neverDrawn is empty.
Samuel pours oil on kneeling David while Jesse and three sons stand to the left. The pale swirling light above remains nonfigurative and the scene shows no lettering or gore.
A luminous cloud hovers over the central tabernacle while families sit, tend fires and remain among their tents. The scene fills all edges and the cloud has no bodily form.
Hezekiah stands among priests, offerings and workers in the temple court. Foreground tools and masonry work are coherent, and the scrolls at right are rolled without visible writing.
Text is visible on the loose papers and open pages at left, and the clock bears dial marks. The seated Holmes strongly resembles Benedict Cumberbatch; the masked visitor's entrance otherwise matches.
The linen-clad priest releases white feathers over an ash pile beside the smoking altar, with the sanctuary tent behind. The small remains are restrained and show no lingering gore.
Elisha walks with bowed head at left while young men jeer from the town gate at right. Broad white paper margins remain along the bottom and sides of the wash.

The large closing stone stands beside a wide-open cave entrance while Darius stamps wax on the ground in front. The den is therefore visibly unsealed, contradicting the requested act of sealing its closing stone.

The four travellers move toward the viewer with the burning house behind them, reversing the requested approach toward the blaze. Holmes has a recognizable screen-Holmes likeness, and white paper remains around the wash edges.
Printed columns are visible on the flying newspaper bundle and papers across the seats and floor. Holmes has a strong Benedict Cumberbatch likeness while making the requested throw toward the rack.

Hezekiah gestures amid temple workers and offerings, with exposed paper along the lower edge. The man behind the right basin appears to handle a scroll at its rim; the overlap is odd but does not establish malformed anatomy.
The station-master holds a visibly printed paper, and Holmes strongly resembles Benedict Cumberbatch. The group strides away from the burning house behind them instead of toward it.
Script-like lines appear on the papers lying on the tabletop. Holmes's face strongly resembles Benedict Cumberbatch, though the paper inspection and startled companion fit the scene.

A full spear flies from Saul toward David, but a second isolated spearhead protrudes backward from the wall beside David's head. That reversed, shaftless wall fragment makes the weapon arrangement contradictory.
Moses raises the rod beside a strong jet of water as people and livestock approach the stream. Exposed white paper runs along the lower and side boundaries.

Four many-eyed winged creatures surround an empty radiant throne above a glassy expanse, with John small below. The human-faced creature is part of the requested four, not a divine figure on the throne.
Rephaiah gestures toward a breached wall while workers carry blocks, mortar and tools beside a loaded cart. The repair site is spatially coherent and no writing is visible.
Peter places one foot on the water while stepping from the boat toward Jesus, who also stands on its surface. Watching disciples and the boat lamp match the night scene.
Light fills the open gateway as people carry grain and jars toward storehouses and lift their hands. No separate personification of Wisdom or figure made of radiance appears.
Posted notes, book spines and the clock contain writing or numeral-like marks, with small exposed paper corners. Holmes at left has the recognizable curly-haired Benedict Cumberbatch likeness.
Numerous script marks cover the table papers, including the hotel-bill fragment, and the mantel clock has numerals. Holmes strongly resembles Benedict Cumberbatch; the artwork reaches the edges.
Moses extends an arm toward a channel opening between water walls while the Israelites wait at right. The overhead light remains a plain column and cloud without a divine face or body.

Alice's arm resting over the chair ends in an oversized, adult-looking hand disproportionate to her other hand and forearm. The tea party otherwise shows the requested four characters and no visible inscription.
Darius presses a seal onto a slab that covers only part of the pit, leaving a large open gap at left. The requested closed, sealed den is not achieved; white paper remains along the lower wash edge.
Holmes beside the pointing engineer has a clear Benedict Cumberbatch likeness. The bandaged engineer, roses, burning windows and firefighting activity otherwise match the scene.
Jesus lies on a cushion at lower right as a disciple reaches to wake him and others struggle amid water in the boat. The storm and figures form a coherent, restrained scene.
Chariots and horsemen charge away from the viewer along a dry seabed beneath curling water walls. Horses, wheels and pursuing soldiers are consistent with the requested action.
Playing-card figures in the background bear visible suit glyphs on their rectangular bodies. Alice whispers toward the floating cat head while the Queen leans nearby, with no clear anatomy fault.

The pocket watch has numerals and the card figures carry corner letters and suit glyphs. The Hatter holds an intact-looking cup away from his mouth instead of biting a piece out of it, missing the requested focal action.
A single spear has struck the wall just beside the dodging David while Saul's throwing arm remains extended. The smoke is formless, and small white paper areas remain at the right edge.

A lone weary man steps along the road with Jerusalem behind him and white paper at the lower and left edges. He remains noticeably stooped, so renewed strength is ambiguous rather than clearly visible.
The father reaches the ragged son and gathers him into an embrace on a rural road. Small exposed paper areas remain along the lower edge; the overlapping arms have plausible owners.
Many crates have stencilled lettering, including 'BULLION' and 'BANK'. The kneeling Holmes strongly resembles Benedict Cumberbatch, although the lantern-and-lens inspection is correctly staged.
Rephaiah gestures from the left while workers lay blocks, carry baskets and move a stone-loaded cart. Small white paper areas are visible along the watercolor perimeter.
David crouches at the brook lifting a smooth stone beside an open bag already holding stones, with staff and sling close at hand. No prominent extra figure or visible inscription appears.
The folded newspaper under the station-master's arm has printed columns. Bradstreet looks toward the large smoke plume while two men remain at the train door, matching the requested station scene.

The hovering beings have exposed bare feet and several have uncovered heads or only two visible wings, rather than six-winged seraphim concealing both faces and feet. One also carries coal tongs from another action, while Isaiah stands below.
The Hatter's small waist watch contains numeral-like dial marks. White paper is exposed at the left and lower wash edges; the gesturing tea-table conversation otherwise matches.
Goliath's airborne body is sharply arched with an inverted, upward-facing face rather than falling face-first. He wears a helmet while another helmet lies below him, duplicating the same prop.
Alice holds the bottle to her lips beside the small table, with a tiny closed door behind her. The hanging bottle tag is blank, and the interior fills every edge.
Daniel addresses the seated king with open hands in the banquet hall, with attendants and gold vessels to either side. The wall remains blank and no extraneous divine figure is present.
Egyptian chariots and mounted soldiers pursue down the open seabed between high walls of water. The foreground teams, drivers and wheels form a coherent charge without visible inscriptions.

The priest drops feathers beside the altar, but the composition includes both a small complete tabernacle compound at left and a second oversized sanctuary immediately behind him. This reads as a combined overview and close scene; broad white paper margins remain below.
Alice speaks across the tea table as the Hatter raises a cup, the Hare leans forward and the Dormouse dozes in a large cup. The exaggerated animal posture is intentional and no lettering is visible.
Fire descends onto two burning walled cities while small groups flee across the plain. The cloud opening has no face, and exposed white paper appears at the side and lower wash edges.

Daniel stands calmly amid closed-mouthed lions while Darius leans over the pit rim. Radiance spreads behind Daniel without a distinct additional face or body; some lions stand rather than lie but the protection scene is clear.

An elderly man lies peacefully with folded hands as family members sit around his bed in the courtyard. White paper remains along parts of the lower and left edges, and the death is depicted without gore.
Peter leaps from the boat clutching his cloak toward Jesus and a small shore fire, while the beloved disciple points. White paper is exposed around the outer watercolor edges.
Alice looks up toward a grinning, clawed cat crouched on the branch at upper right. Small white paper margins remain at the lower corners and sides; the cat's exaggerated grin is intentional.
Naomi cradles the infant while women gather around her at the house threshold, including one holding bundled cloth. Exposed paper shows at the lower-left edge, and no writing is visible.
A broad beam of light spreads across dark primordial water beneath heavy clouds. There is no land, human-shaped radiance, face, lettering or unpainted border.
The flat card courtiers carry visible suit glyphs and corner marks. White paper remains around parts of the garden wash; Alice whispers to the floating cat head with the Queen directly behind her.

The lower-right crate has prominent stencilled lettering, and small exposed paper corners surround the wash. The kneeling Holmes has the recognizable Benedict Cumberbatch face while inspecting the floor seam.

The priest drops feathers beside an altar, but a small complete sanctuary compound is repeated as a second giant sanctuary and altar arrangement at right. The overlapping overview and close view make the place inconsistent.
Peter dives horizontally from the boat toward the shore while a disciple points and Jesus stands beside the beach fire. His coat remains around him, and the limbs and boat arrangement are coherent.
